card: ROLE: Airborne combatant who led the ascent above a mushroom-dome settlement on a world of crushing gravity and overcame the Magon tribe's resistance, fulfilling their ancient prophecy.
TRAIT: Silver-haired; capable of floating or sustained airborne movement.
TRAIT: Armed with extended metal claws employed in close-quarters combat against alien tribal creatures.
TRAIT: Resolute under threat; pressed the ascent above the domes despite explicit warnings against it.
TRAIT: Dangerous when seized; reversed a giant creature's capture of him by tearing through its head.
RELATIONSHIP: Bound by sworn brotherhood to an ape companion; followed the ape into the contested upper territory above the settlement.

RELATIONSHIP: Recognized by the Magon people after the confrontation as the fulfillment of their prophecy — the 'little no-hair white ape' destined to lead them to the fog world and the Diamond Planet.
VOICE: No direct speech recorded; defined entirely by physical action and refusal to yield.

BOUNDARY: Kioka is not a confirmed personal name; the Magon invocation of that name after the confrontation may refer to Kiowotai, to his ape companion, or to a prophetic figure perceived in the encounter.
BOUNDARY: Whether Kiowotai is the humanoid combatant or the ape companion in these events is not resolved; he may be another name for the main character present in those pages.
BOUNDARY: No origin, backstory, stable secondary name, or activity beyond the ascent and the Magon confrontation is established.
